notes: All three pages are UBC Sauder 'PhD in Business Administration' alumni tables, one page per year (2006, 2015, 1990), each read from Common Crawl captures (2006: CC-MAIN-2017-47 and 2018-26; 2015: CC-MAIN-2017-47 and 2018-26; 1990: CC-MAIN-2017-47, 2018-30 and 2019-09). Every snapshot of a page carries the identical table and the same 'Last Updated on 9/20/2017' line, so rows repeat across snapshots by design. The year is the page's alumni-year heading; the page never states whether it is the graduation year, so yearMeaning is 'unstated' (the intro 'Since graduating its first student in 1972' and the year index starting at 1972 suggest graduation year, but that is the integrator's call). The 'Current University' column is a current affiliation as of the 2017 update, not a first job; no positions are given. Columns: 2006 and 1990 pages use 'Division', the 2015 page uses 'Specialization'; the codes (SC, TLOG/SBE, POL/SC, MIS, OB, FIN, ACC, MKT, POL/MIS) are copied as written into the program field. Three 1990 alumni (Darcie Lee Booth, Kenneth Takagaki, Savita Verma) have an empty Current University cell. Personal email addresses printed on the page were deliberately not copied. The pages are explicitly doctoral alumni pages; no master's graduates are mixed in.
